section.content: 本发明公开种人工智能机器学习书法评分系统。该系统由采集终端、互联网和人工智能深度学习书法评分系统组成。所述的采集终端将拍照或扫描采集的书法图片，通过互联网送给人工智能深度学习书法评分系统，所述的人工智能深度学习书法评分系统将书法分为，结构、字和书写力度三个方面，按10分评分，并将该三个评分加权综合评分，给出最终评分结果。

The present invention discloses a kind of artificial intelligence machine learning calligraphy points-scoring system.The system is made of acquisition terminal, internet and artificial intelligence deep learning calligraphy points-scoring system.The acquisition terminal will take pictures or the calligraphy picture of scanning collection, artificial intelligence deep learning calligraphy points-scoring system is given by internet, calligraphy is divided by the artificial intelligence deep learning calligraphy points-scoring system, three structure, word and writing physical strength aspects, it scores by 10 points, and this three scoring weighted comprehensives score, provide final appraisal result.

A kind of artificial intelligence machine learning calligraphy points-scoring systemTechnical field

The present invention relates to artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, and the application in calligraphy work rank scores, especially It is to be related to a kind of artificial intelligence machine learning calligraphy points-scoring system.

Background technique

Chinese calligraphy is of extensive knowledge and profound scholarship, beautiful beauty, is one of the traditional culture rarity of China's invention.Current calligraphy scoring Method is all to design scoring main points according to certain appreciation standard, carries out subjective scoring by reading and appraising expert.It scores and marks in calligraphy In standard, designed scoring main points seem very careful, very specifically, such as: it is superb work, quality goods, energy to strokes and dots basic training scoring Product, are not got started at introduction, and equally, to word structure and moulding, layout scores and has similar scoring to scoring etc. of communicating views Rule.But it is practical score calligraphy work when operating, the exquisite language of those descriptions is difficult to implement to specific calligraphy and comment On point.Moreover, different experts and teacher's appraisal result is irregular, consistency is poor.

Artificial intelligence machine study, especially deep learning achieves huge in image recognition, natural language processing etc. Big success, especially in terms of classification, as long as there is sufficiently large data set, their accuracy in terms of image classification are very It is high.

The present invention is learnt by artificial intelligence machine, especially deep learning image classification method, solves calligraphy work mirror Appreciate rank scores problem.

Summary of the invention

The present invention discloses a kind of artificial intelligence machine learning calligraphy points-scoring system.The system by acquisition terminal, internet and Artificial intelligence deep learning calligraphy points-scoring system composition.The acquisition terminal will take pictures or the calligraphy picture of scanning collection, leads to It crosses internet and gives artificial intelligence deep learning calligraphy points-scoring system, the artificial intelligence deep learning calligraphy points-scoring system will Calligraphy is divided into, and three structure, word and writing physical strength aspects score, and this three scoring weighted comprehensives are scored by 10 points, provide Final appraisal result.

According to an aspect of the present invention, the calligraphy work is scanned or taken pictures by the acquisition terminal passes through interconnection Net gives the calligraphy points-scoring system.

Further, the acquisition terminal shows calligraphy work collected and appraisal result.

Further, the acquisition terminal is loaded into a manner of App realizes the function on smart phone.

In accordance with a further aspect of the present invention, the calligraphy points-scoring system is according to the succession (body) of calligraphy and integral layout The respectively scoring of three aspect such as (chapter), font architecture (shape), writing physical strength (power), and weighted comprehensive provides the calligraphy work Appraisal result.

Further, the calligraphy points-scoring system is respectively by layout scoring subsystem, word structure scoring subsystem, the technique of writing Score subsystem composition.

Further, calligraphy work scoring is classified according to font scores, such as regular script, running hand, kerria's book etc..

Further, ten point system scoring is respectively adopted in the subsystem.

Further, the comprehensive score is the result is that the weighted average score value that each subsystem scores.

Comprehensive score

Further, weighted value(i=1,2,3) less than 1, but.Adjust three scoring subsystem outputs Weight, its weight in comprehensive score can be adjusted separately.

In accordance with a further aspect of the present invention, the scoring of the integral layout (chapter) of the font is directly to write to standard Entire chapter calligraphy scores.

Further, the scoring is 10 grades, 10 points corresponding.

In accordance with a further aspect of the present invention, the word structure and technique of writing scoring subsystem will score for the calligraphy Individual word in works scores.Specific practice is that taking out n word at random in the calligraphy scoring works, (n is less than whole The total number of word of secondary works), carry out word structure and technique of writing scoring respectively to each word, and appraisal result is averaged as institute State the appraisal result of subsystem.

In accordance with a further aspect of the present invention, the described technique of writing scoring subsystem by for each stroke of taken out word into Row scoring, specific practice is to take out the stroke of the word at random, is independently scored each stroke, and appraisal result is made even Appraisal result of the mean value as technique of writing scoring subsystem.

In accordance with a further aspect of the present invention, calligraphy scoring subsystem is all a deep learning classification system respectively System, the categorizing system are designed to achievable 10 classification, 10 points of appraisal results of the corresponding system.

Further, the scoring subsystem is convolutional neural networks (CNN) categorizing system.System by input layer, hide Layer and output layer composition.Input is calligraphy work image, and output is rank scores result.

Further, the input layer is standardized the input picture.

Further, the hidden layer is a multilayer convolutional neural networks, at least one layer of convolutional layer, at least one layer Pond layer, at least one full articulamentum, and full articulamentum complete 10 classification outputs by dimensionality reduction.

Further, the categorizing system is trained by a large amount of training sample, these training samples are the one of data sample Part, data sample have been concentrated largely by calligraphy great masters or experienced writing master, according to standard calligraphy rank scores mark The sample of fiducial mark note.

Further, the data sample is divided into training set, test set and verifying to collect.

In accordance with a further aspect of the present invention, the categorizing system calligraphy work is according to 10 rank scores, i.e. 10 points of correspondences 10 classification.

The beneficial effects of the present invention are:

The present invention is learnt by artificial intelligence machine, especially deep learning image classification method, solves calligraphy work appreciation point Grade scoring problem；

Artificial intelligence machine learning calligraphy points-scoring system provided by the invention reduces the artificial intensity of extensive calligraphy scoring, Human resources are saved, and make appraisal result more objective；

The present invention provides real-time scoring for calligraphy learner, and that detects oneself learning outcome facilitates approach, to learning calligraphy, religion Learning and promoting has great social benefit.
